# Adoption repairs in the P35–P63 execution sequence

October28,2026. This is a prompt-plan update, not completed UI work. It implements the owner's instruction to incorporate the [midway audit](ADOPTION-AUDIT.md) into the remaining build sequence. Source baseline ad500b3026db2ea9b84f30b2fb1d36a8bd1668f4. P34's local mutation slice remains delivered; P35/P36 have no implementation. Provider/privacy/institutional/human/recovery gates remain open.

**Execution:** Use the existing checkout/branch/chat and one numbered prompt at a time. No agents or worktrees. The original three actions and A1–A3 remain intact; new adoption work and U checks are mandatory additions. Each coherent batch may need its own CONTINUE execution under the existing usage ceiling. Record local implementation, browser/automated checks and actual human evidence separately; no audit finding closes from a plan edit.

The task/deliverable short-reference allocator is an implementation requirement now assigned to P36, while its exact qualified uniqueness/backfill design is reviewed there. Never truncate UUIDs, renumber issued requests, use mutable labels as keys or treat knowing a short reference as authorization. New ordinary namespace prefixes are short by default at P38; historical long prefixes remain valid. Exact cross-term search is P43; P36 delivers safe authorized list/detail/copy references first.

## Plan review

Single-assistant simulated newcomer, governance and skeptical delivery perspectives support this order: repair the ordinary workflow before multiplying editors, preserve immutable authorization, and checkpoint small batches rather than promising one giant P35 run. The credible alternative—adding only a generic simplicity sentence to every prompt—would leave ownership and verification ambiguous. No independent reviewer/agent participated. The owner has authorized this plan update; it does not itself execute the numbered builds or waive any gate.
